links.comparator_used: Unaligned LLM-as-a-judge scores (before calibration to expert ratings); not a comparison with expert review of every output
links.outcome: Agreement between LLM judge and expert ratings (Cohen κ) and filtering of suggestions by aligned usefulness score
links.effect: Cohen κ improved from 0.06 to 0.41 after expert alignment; filtering with aligned scores reduced total suggestions by 29% while retaining 92% of useful suggestions
links.tradeoff: Filtering discarded about 8% of useful suggestions; agreement remained moderate (κ 0.41)
links.quote: After expert alignment, Cohen κ improved from 0.06 to 0.41.
